== Biography ==
Anna Glasgow was born before 1820, probably in South Carolina. In the 1835 equity partition of [[Glasgow-1983|Robert Glasgow]]'s estate, Anna and her husband James Fair appeared as complainants, and the pleading identified Anna as one of Robert's children.<ref name="RobertEstate1835">Newberry District, South Carolina, equity partition of the estate of Robert Glasgow, 1835; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K FamilySearch image].</ref>

The proceeding directly establishes Robert as Anna's father and James Fair as her husband. It does not identify Anna's mother or give her exact birth or death dates.
